pages.title: Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix
pages.text: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load. Without it, extra dimensions tend to unroll, and the laws of physics shift. It looks like a tight knot of light, faintly warm.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the String Resonance Loom I wove Quantum Strings through a Calabi-Yau Manifold with a Topological Insulator and Exotic Matter. The compact dimensions held their shape even under pressure.
